name: push-guard
description: Runs the project's tests before any git push (npm test, or test:all, plus test:* suites and workspaces; with no test script, its typecheck and lint scripts), non-interactively and within a time limit, blocks the push if a test fails (with Baseline installed, only if this push broke it), if a command does not finish, or if the push changes existing tests, and shows the last result above the prompt

testChanges.title: Pushes that change existing tests
testChanges.description: block holds a push whose commits remove lines from, delete or rename a test file until you type /push-guard allow; warn lets it through with a note; off does not look.

baseline.title: Use Baseline
baseline.description: auto: when Baseline is installed, run the tests through it and block only on failures this push caused; tests already failing before it, flaky or failing for environment reasons let it through with a note. off: never use it (block on any failing test).

checks.title: Projects without a test script
checks.description: auto: run the project's typecheck, type-check, tsc, lint, check and format:check scripts instead (through Baseline when it is installed, blocking only on errors this push brought in); with none of them, push anyway but say loudly that nothing was checked. all: also run build. off: run nothing and say nothing.

timeoutMinutes.title: Time limit per script (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: How long each test or check script may take, Baseline and the plain run together. 1 to 15 (a value outside is brought into that range; one command runs 10 minutes at most). A script that does not finish in time blocks the push.

suites.title: Which test scripts run
suites.description: auto: test:all when package.json has it, else test plus the test:* suites beside it (not watch, e2e, UI, coverage or device ones), and with npm workspaces also npm test --workspaces --if-present. root: only npm test. Either way, test scripts found but not run (a test:api, an api/package.json) are named loudly.
